title: Set 180

sentences.ko: 주말에 하려던 게 엄청 많았는데, 결국 일요일 밤까지 잠옷 차림으로 있었어. 근데 있잖아, 하나도 후회 안 해. 생각했던 것보다 나한테 그게 더 필요했나 봐.
sentences.text: I had all these plans for the weekend, but I ended up staying in my pajamas till Sunday night, and you know what, I don't regret it at all. I think I needed it more than I realized.

alts.text: Had a ton of plans this weekend, but I wound up in my pajamas till Sunday night, and honestly? Zero regrets. Guess I needed it more than I thought.
I had a number of plans for the weekend, but I ended up remaining in my pajamas until Sunday evening, and I do not regret it in the slightest. I believe I needed it more than I had realized.

sentences.note: **ended up** 는 계획과 달리 결국 ~하게 됐다는 말이에요. **you know what** 은 말을 꺼내기 전에 상대의 주의를 끄는 표현으로, 있잖아 정도의 느낌이에요.
sentences.situation: 주말에 아무것도 안 하고 쉰 게 좋았다고 말하기

sentences.ko: 늦어서 미안. 알람 때문에 일이 좀 있었는데 얘기하자면 길어. 그러니까 그냥 차가 막혔다고 하고 넘어가면 안 될까?
sentences.text: Sorry I'm late. There was this whole thing with my alarm, and it's kind of a long story, so can we just say it was traffic and leave it at that?

alts.text: My bad. Alarm drama, long story. Can we just say traffic and leave it at that?
I apologize for arriving late. There was an issue with my alarm, and it is rather a long story, so might we simply say it was traffic and leave it at that?

sentences.note: **leave it at that** 은 더 묻지 말고 거기까지만 하자는 말이에요. **a long story** 는 얘기하자면 길다는 뜻으로 자세히 말하고 싶지 않을 때 써요.

sentences.ko: 여기 자리 있어요? 죄송해요, 쟁반 들고 한 10분째 돌아다녔는데 빈 의자가 여기 하나밖에 없네요.
sentences.text: Is anyone sitting here? Sorry, I've been walking around with this tray for like ten minutes, and this is the only open chair in the whole place.

alts.text: This seat taken? Sorry, I've been wandering around with this tray for like ten minutes, and it's the only free chair in the whole place.
Pardon me, is anyone sitting here? I apologize, but I have been walking around with this tray for about ten minutes, and this is the only available chair in the entire place.

sentences.note: **Is anyone sitting here?** 는 빈자리처럼 보이는 곳에 앉아도 되는지 물을 때 쓰는 표현이에요. **open chair** 는 비어 있는 의자를 말해요.

sentences.ko: 부엌 싱크대 고치는 법 찾으려고 유튜브를 켰을 뿐인데, 어쩌다 보니 두 시간 뒤에는 웬 아저씨가 낡은 배 복원하는 걸 보고 있더라. 싱크대는 아직도 물이 새고.
sentences.text: I only opened YouTube to figure out how to fix the kitchen sink, and somehow two hours later I was watching some guy restore an old boat, and the sink's still leaking.

alts.text: Went on YouTube just to see how to fix the kitchen sink, and somehow two hours later I'm watching some guy fix up an old boat. Sink's still leaking.
I only went on YouTube to learn how to repair the kitchen sink, and somehow, two hours later, I was watching a man restore an old boat, and the sink is still leaking.

sentences.note: **figure out** 은 방법을 알아내다, 이해하다라는 뜻이에요. **somehow** 는 어쩌다 보니, 나도 모르게라는 느낌을 줘요.
sentences.situation: 유튜브 보다가 시간 다 날린 얘기

sentences.ko: 그 드라마 예전엔 진짜 좋아했는데, 시즌 2 지나고 나서는 아이디어가 좀 바닥난 것 같더라고. 그래서 지금은 그냥 습관처럼 계속 보는 것 같아.
sentences.text: I used to love that show, but after the second season they kind of ran out of ideas, so now I just keep watching it out of habit, I guess.

alts.text: Used to love that show, but after season two they kinda ran out of ideas, so now I'm just watching out of habit, I guess.
I was once very fond of that program, but after the second season they seemed to run out of ideas, so I now continue watching it simply out of habit, I suppose.

sentences.note: **ran out of ideas** 는 아이디어가 바닥났다는 말이에요. **out of habit** 은 습관적으로, 버릇처럼이라는 뜻이에요.

reviewed: 2번 casual 의 kinda a long story 는 소리내면 어색하고, leave it there 는 관용구 leave it at that 을 흐트러뜨린 것이라 더 짧은 구어로 새로 씀
3번 한국어 여기 통틀어서 가 번역투라 자연스럽게 고침
5번 한국어 좀 아이디어가 바닥났더라고 의 어순이 어색해 고침
